original_ai_output.title_zh: 巴西大选进入第二轮，右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗赢得首轮
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 巴西总统选举首轮投票中，右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗击败现任左翼总统卢拉·达席尔瓦。但他未获得直接胜选所需的超过50%选票，选举将进入第二轮。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗赢得巴西总统选举首轮
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round

key_facts.fact: 弗拉维奥·博索纳罗击败现任左翼总统卢拉·达席尔瓦
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro has won the first round of Brazil's presidential election, beating the incumbent left-wing President Lula da Silva.

key_facts.fact: 他未获得直接胜选所需的超过50%选票，选举进入第二轮
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: But he did not obtain more than 50% of the votes required to win outright.
